title: defaultReconcile's unbounded fromBlock:"earliest" eth_getLogs scan -- now reachable for the FIRST time against a real public RPC by this exact fix -- is untested against real provider block-range limits, directly threatening REQ-118b's own 'never a permanent block' guarantee for the real stuck loan_Franklin_1 row
description: lending-orchestrator.mjs's defaultReconcile (lines 160-167) calls reconcileProvisionalDisbursement with `fromBlock: deps.reconcileFromBlock || "earliest"`. wake-gate.mjs's own deps object passed into executeLoanIssuanceAttempt (lines 166-178) never sets `reconcileFromBlock`, so production reconciliation for the REAL stuck row (loan_Franklin_1, confirmed live at /Users/operator/.blockrun/skills/economy/lending/state/loans.jsonl) will call `eth_getLogs` against `https://mainnet.base.org` (the real deps.rpcUrl this fix now wires in) with `fromBlock:"earliest"`, `toBlock:"latest"` -- i.e. the ENTIRE Base mainnet chain history (millions of blocks since the Aug 2023 genesis). Public JSON-RPC providers, including Base's own public endpoint, near-universally reject or truncate eth_getLogs calls spanning more than a small block range (commonly 2,000-10,000 blocks) -- this is exactly the failure mode this SAME codebase already documented and fixed once before: skills/self/founder-loop/record-earn.mjs line 122 explicitly caps its own eth_getLogs scan span with the comment 'FIND-702: cap the scan span so a single eth_getLogs never exceeds the provider's block-range limit (a silent...' -- yet lending-orchestrator.mjs's defaultReconcile (already-converged, sprint-2, out of this fix's diff but made reachable in production for the FIRST time by this fix's own deps.rpcUrl wiring) applies no such cap. If mainnet.base.org rejects the request (block-range-too-large error, or simply times out), reconcile() throws, resolveStaleProvisioning catches it and returns `{ok:false, reason:'reconciliation_failed'}` (lending-orchestrator.mjs lines 108-113), which runLockedIssuance immediately surfaces as `{status:'refused', reason:'reconciliation_failed'}` BEFORE any new sequence number is ever consumed -- i.e. the exact 'permanently blocks the lender's every subsequent wake forever' failure mode the feature's own behavioral-spec.md (lines 18-22, 50-54) explicitly says this fix must resolve. This is precisely the row/path this feature exists to unstick, and it is untested against anything resembling a real provider's constraints -- the ONLY test exercising this path (wake-gate.test.mjs's REQ-118 idempotent-recovery test, lines 391-448) uses a fully permissive local mock server that accepts fromBlock/toBlock unconditionally.

additionalEvidence.note: deps object passed to executeLoanIssuanceAttempt never sets reconcileFromBlock -- production always takes the 'earliest' default now that rpcUrl is genuinely wired
this codebase's own prior FIND-702 fix explicitly documents and caps this exact eth_getLogs block-range-limit failure mode -- the pattern this fix's own reconciliation path does not apply
the real, currently-stuck loan_Franklin_1 disbursement_uncertain row that this exact reconciliation path must resolve on the very next wake
startMockRpc's eth_getLogs handler ignores fromBlock/toBlock entirely and always succeeds -- cannot exercise or catch a real provider's block-range rejection
